text_en: The elder to the beloved Gaius, whom I love in truth.
text_cn: 我长老致书给可爱的加约，就是我在真理内所爱的。

text_en: Beloved, I pray that all may go well with you and that you may be in good health, just as it is well with your soul.
text_cn: 亲爱的，祝你诸事顺利，并祝你健康，就如你的灵魂常顺利一样。

text_en: I was overjoyed when some of the friends arrived and testified to your faithfulness to the truth, namely how you walk in the truth.
text_cn: 有些弟兄来，证明你在真理内，就是说你怎样在真理内生活，我很是高兴。

text_en: I have no greater joy than this, to hear that my children are walking in the truth.
text_cn: 我听说我的孩子们在真理内生活，我没有比这再大的喜乐了。

text_en: Beloved, you do faithfully whatever you do for the friends, even though they are strangers to you;
text_cn: 亲爱的，凡你对弟兄，尤其对旅客所行的，都是真信徒的行为。

text_en: they have testified to your love before the church. You will do well to send them on in a manner worthy of God;
text_cn: 他们在教会前证明了你的爱德。你若以相称天主的态度，帮助他们走上旅途，就是做了善事，

text_en: for they began their journey for the sake of Christ, accepting no support from non-believers.
text_cn: 因为他们出发是为主的名字，并没有从外教人接受什么；

text_en: Therefore we ought to support such people, so that we may become co-workers with the truth.
text_cn: 所以我们应当款待这样的人，为叫我们成为与真理合作的人。

text_en: I have written something to the church; but Diotrephes, who likes to put himself first, does not acknowledge our authority.
text_cn: 我给教会写过信，但是那在他们中间爱作首领的狄约勒斐，却不承认我们。

text_en: So if I come, I will call attention to what he is doing in spreading false charges against us. And not content with those charges, he refuses to welcome the friends, and even prevents those who want to do so and expels them from the church.
text_cn: 为此，我若来到，必要指摘他所行的事，就是他用恶言恶语诽谤我们的事；但这为他还不够：他自己不款待弟兄们，连那愿意款待的，他也加以阻止，甚而将他们逐出教会。

text_en: Beloved, do not imitate what is evil but imitate what is good. Whoever does good is from God; whoever does evil has not seen God.
text_cn: 亲爱的，你不要效法恶，但要效法善：那行善的是出于天主，那作恶的是没有见过天主。

text_en: Everyone has testified favorably about Demetrius, and so has the truth itself. We also testify for him, and you know that our testimony is true.
text_cn: 众人和真理本身都给德默特琉作证，我们自己也给他作证，而你也知道我们所作的证是真实的。

text_en: I have much to write to you, but I would rather not write with pen and ink;
text_cn: 我本来有许多事要写给你，但是我不愿意以笔墨给你写；

text_en: instead I hope to see you soon, and we will talk together face to face.
text_cn: 只希望快见到你，我们好亲口面谈。

text_en: Peace to you. The friends send you their greetings. Greet the friends there, each by name.
text_cn: 祝你平安！朋友都问候你。请你也一一问候各位朋友。
